title: Christmas Cards
seo_title: Christmas Cards Class in Lebanon, MO on Nov 18
description: This is a card-making class where you create 8 Christmas cards from the Kringle & Co. Collection. Bring your own adhesives and trimmers; everything else is provided, and the cost is $29, with sign-up by Oct 20 so products can be ordered on time. It takes place November 18, 2026 (Time TBD) at 301 W. Commercial in Lebanon, MO, with another session offered on Nov 21.
address: 301 W Commercial St, Lebanon, MO 65536-3105, United States, Lebanon, MO
